\# Ethernet LAN Switching



\## Objective



Analyze how Ethernet switches learn MAC addresses and forward frames

during ARP and ICMP communication.



\## Scenario



Both switches initially have empty MAC address tables and all PCs have

empty ARP tables.



The lab examines the traffic generated when PC1 communicates with PC3

and how the switches learn the MAC addresses of connected hosts.



\## Tasks



* Predicted the traffic generated by a ping from PC1 to PC3.
* Analyzed ARP and ICMP traffic using Packet Tracer Simulation Mode.
* Observed ARP broadcast behavior.
* Observed unicast forwarding of ARP replies and ICMP messages.
* Generated traffic to populate switch MAC address tables.
* Used Cisco IOS `show` commands to inspect learned MAC addresses.
* Cleared dynamically learned MAC addresses from the switches.



\## Protocols



* ARP
* ICMP
* Ethernet



\## Concepts



* MAC address learning
* MAC address table
* ARP table
* Broadcast
* Unicast
* Ethernet frame forwarding



\## Skills Demonstrated

* Cisco Packet Tracer Simulation Mode
* Cisco IOS CLI
* Ethernet switching
* ARP analysis
* MAC address table analysis
* Network traffic analysis
